UNRESOLVED SOURCE OBSERVATION (not a hi defect, preserved from the manager's brief and verified): the tour tells the reader to click "Create schedule" (create_schedule.body.1), whose Hindi matches that quote and the existing hi label for ui.schedules.schedule_form_dialog.create_schedule. The Schedules page's own call to action is a different label: ui.schedules.schedules_page.new_scheduled_task = "New scheduled task" (and the older engine note says new scheduled tasks are created as wakes in a conversation). So the quoted control may not exist on the spotlighted surface. This is a source/UX question; the target cannot resolve it by rewriting the quote.

UNRESOLVED SOURCE OBSERVATION (not a hi defect, preserved and verified): the settings prefix is a bare comma code span in the source (SCOPE_PREFIXES ',' → setting is correct per palette-search.ts), so the joined sentence reads ', सेटिंग्स के लिए' inside a comma-separated list. The glyph is accurate; the ambiguity is typographic and belongs to the source/palette rendering, not to the Hindi. It needs a rendered check or an authoring decision (e.g. a visible keycap style for prefix chips).

The chosen tour term परिचय also occurs in its ordinary 'describe' sense at upload_agent_hub_dialog.body.1 ('जो एजेंट का परिचय देता है'). That is normal polysemy, not a term conflict; noted only so a future grep for परिचय is not mistaken for drift.
